articles.title: SpaceX's Cursor weighs phasing out Chinese AI models over geopolitical risk, CNBC reports
articles.description: SpaceX's AI platform Cursor is reportedly considering discontinuing Chinese AI models because of geopolitical risks. This decision follows a congressional investigation into the integration of such models into American technology. Companies like Airbnb and DoorDash have also been part of the inquiry regarding their AI practices. Meanwhile, the Trump administration is contemplating requiring public disclosures about the use of Chinese AI models.
